# Задача: разбор HTTP/2

`h2_stream.txt` — декодированные кадры HTTP/2.
Найди запрос, который сделал клиент, и метку.

1. `cat h2_stream.txt`.
2. `grep -i ':method\|:path' h2_stream.txt`.
3. `grep nto h2_stream.txt > found.txt`.

HTTP/2 connection (decoded frames)
stream 1: HEADERS  :method=GET :scheme=https :authority=api.local :path=/v1/users
stream 1: HEADERS  authorization: Bearer eyJ...  user-agent: curl/8.0
stream 1: DATA     {"id":42}
stream 3: HEADERS  :method=POST :path=/v1/upload
stream 3: DATA     (binary payload 4096 bytes)
stream 3: DATA     (binary payload 8192 bytes)
note: h2 marker nto{http2_hpack_fr4m3s}
